text:
sarah_cs: Heads-up — Lumenix renewal is blocked on two things: (1) 2 seats not signed by their CFO, (2) vendor code missing on the PO. DocSend with SOW/quote: https://docsend.com/s/abcd1234. Can someone help route the esign and confirm vendor code so we can finalize the commit?

jordan_ae: looping in procurement team shortly. do we have the PO number yet?

michael_ops: PO not in our system. customer said they'll attach PO once vendor code is provided. requesting mapping: is this EU entity or US?

sarah_cs: it's the UK entity (Lumenix UK Ltd). Their email said net30, but procurement wants PO + vendor code first. seats changed in negotiation — was 12, sold 10. quick snippet: `seats: 12 -> 10`

emma_se: @sarah_cs I can create the DocuSign routing with the reduced seat SOW and route to CFO + procurement contact. who should be cc'd?

sarah_cs: cc procurement contact is claire@lumenix.co.uk and CFO is tom.garrett@lumenix.co.uk. prefer we get signature by EOD tomorrow if possible.

procurement_bot: Auto-check: vendor code lookup for "Lumenix UK Ltd" returned no matches. Suggest: provide vendorCode override request to finance.

nina_legal: Quick note — the SOW for reduced seats needs a minor amendment to section 2 (billing proration). I can pre-approve the language. small change: add "prorated for reduction effective at renewal".

emma_se: ok i'll add nina's clause, generate DocuSign, and ping Claire/Tom. drafting now. will also add a note for finance to create an interim vendor code (assign: FIN-VEND-TEMP) so PO can be attached.

jordan_ae: i'll chase our finance partner Natalie for temp vendor code and escalate if no response in 2 hours. :pray:

michael_ops: for record, updating the CRM: commit value reduced to new seats; hold reason = missing PO/vendor. record id 98765.

sarah_cs: thanks team. please drop final DocuSign link here once ready and i'll confirm with the customer.

emma_se: DocuSign created: https://docusign.com/send/xyz789 — routed to Tom + Claire. added Nina's clause and a finance note. tagging here when signed. :thumbsup:

sarah_cs: received, noted. i'll follow up with the customer to remind Tom. if signed + vendor code by tomorrow we can close renewal.

emma_se: update — Tom opened the envelope at 1728381000, no signature yet. i'll nudge.

jordan_ae: finance replied; temp vendor code FIN-TMP-432 issued. forwarding to customer procurement.

sarah_cs: perfect. status: routing in progress, temp vendor code issued, waiting Tom signature. will update once signed. :white_check_mark:
